result:
My verdict is **REJECT**, written to `orders/ACCEPTANCE.md`.

- **Mostly unbuilt:** only the first three of the six planned work packages were attempted. The last of those got a "revise" from the architect, and that review was never addressed.
- **No web app work:** the gate output says "web: no changes", so there is no board and no web "waiting on me" view.
- **Gates fail:** the full suite has 18 new test failures, 12 of them work-item tests that passed before. Type checking (mypy) reports 28 errors and lint (ruff) reports 10 issues.

Defects in the file, most severe first:
1. Every work-item error crashes because the code creating error responses uses a class it never imports. Users get an internal error instead of the reason.
2. The board, the "waiting on me" page and the blocked-reason display are all missing from the web app.
3. A move that only requests sign-off is reported as a success and logged as a status change, even though nothing moved. The approver list is always empty.
4. Two workflow errors (a sign-off already pending, a workflow not found) aren't turned into proper error responses, so they also show up as internal errors.
5. Creating a team doesn't set up its default workflow. It is only created the first time it's needed, so the planned setup step and its database-permission check are never tested.
